rationale: Darren is building KinkBNB, a privacy-first web3 marketplace that needs mobile and embedded systems expertise to scale its iOS app and Bluetooth-connected device integrations, while Elijah is a mobile-first developer specializing in iOS and embedded systems who could help architect the client-side infrastructure for a crypto wallet-based platform. Both are based in San Francisco and complement each other on the technical execution side—Darren brings 30 years of e-commerce and blockchain architecture conviction, Elijah brings the hands-on iOS and embedded systems chops to ship it.
intro_message: Darren Mckeeman, meet Elijah Arbee — Elijah's mobile and embedded systems expertise (iOS, Bluetooth SDKs) could be valuable as KinkBNB scales its web3 dApp, and Darren's two decades of e-commerce and privacy-preserving blockchain architecture could inform how Elijah approaches developer tooling.
